summary.value: Hotel Lucerne is a boutique hotel at 201 WEST 79TH STREET, NEW YORK, NY 10024, a short walk from the American Museum of Natural History and Central Park. Its French bistro is part of the appeal (Dine At Nice Matin), and it suits travelers who want a quieter neighborhood base. Tripadvisor travelers give it 4.4 of 5 bubbles (3,589 reviews).

description.value: Hotel Lucerne is a boutique hotel at 201 WEST 79TH STREET, NEW YORK, NY 10024 on the Upper West Side. The hotel invites guests to Dine At Nice Matin, its French bistro.
